item.title: Chinese ivory syndicates worsen Zimbabwe’s illicit financial flows
item.description: The 18-year prison sentence handed to Chinese national Cong Yangzhong in late 2025 cast fresh light and exposed the scale of illicit financial flows fueling wildlife crime in Zimbabwe.

item.title: Delays in child justice law spark rights concerns
item.description: Children in conflict with the law in Zimbabwe continue to be processed through the general criminal justice system as a three-year delay in signing the Child Justice Bill persists, raising urgent concerns over constitutional compliance and child protection.

item.title: Zimbabwe’s Davos engagement anchored on economic diplomacy, says Murwira
item.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Trade, Professor Dr Amon Murwira, says Zimbabwe's participation at the World Economic Forum (WEF) in Davos is a deliberate strategy rooted in economic diplomacy, aimed at integrating the country into the global economy and delivering tangible benefits to citizens.

item.title: Zimbabwe Engages Swiss Company for World-Class National Stadium Plan
item.description: DAVOS – Zimbabwe’s Ministry of Finance officials have held a high-level meeting with senior executives from the Mabetex Group to advance plans for the construction of a state-of-the-art National Stadium in the country’s new administrative capital, Mount Hampden.
